sources.title: Self-Supervised Any-Point Tracking by Contrastive Random Walks
sources.snippet: The researchers developed a self-supervised approach that uses a transformer model to match points in videos through something called contrastive random walks. Instead of trying to learn everything at once, the model compares all pairs of points to find consistent paths through the video.
